sloka: बालो रहसि हस्तेन कृष्णसर्पमिवास्पृशम् ।मया ह्यपितृकः पुत्रःस महात्मा दुरात्मना ॥२-१२-८२॥
transliteration: bālo rahasi hastena kṛṣṇasarpamivāspṛśam ।mayā hyapitṛkaḥ putraḥsa mahātmā durātmanā ॥2-12-82॥

translations.english: Wicked I am, I have made that magnanimous Rama fatherless. This world of living beings is certainly entitled to condemn me.
